name: Squat to Overhead Reach
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, toes turned slightly out, and arms relaxed at your sides.
Sit your hips back and down into a deep, comfortable squat while keeping your heels flat and chest lifted.
Drive smoothly upward to standing while sweeping both arms straight overhead to lengthen your torso and shoulders.
Lower your arms as you descend back into the next squat, continuing fluidly for the target duration.
tips: Keep your ribs tucked down when reaching overhead rather than arching sharply through your lower back.
Move at a smooth, rhythmic pace to warm up your hips, knees, ankles, and shoulders together.
